about_the_game:
An adult visual novel blending martial arts, passion, and redemption.

You're Russell (name customizable) and were once a professional fighter, climbing the ranks and making a name for yourself. A humiliating loss shattered your career, sending everything spiraling out of control. Sponsors pulled their support, and opportunities disappeared overnight. With no clear direction, you drifted from one meaningless night to the next. When a couple of drunk fans pushed you too far at a bar, you snapped. By the time it was over, they were the ones left broken, and you were facing serious jail time.

Instead of prison, an unexpected deal gave you another option. A judge offered an alternative sentence: provide self-defense training to women for free. It wasn’t what you wanted, but it kept you out of a cell. With no other choice, you accepted.

Your first trainee, Naomi, already has some martial arts experience. She knows the techniques but struggles with confidence. At first, the training is just a requirement to fulfill, but as you work together, you see potential in her. With the right guidance, she could become a serious competitor. While you try to focus on coaching, past troubles refuse to stay in the past. Your loan shark doesn’t care about your situation and demands repayment, with no patience for excuses.

Desperate for a way to fix everything, you come up with a plan. Naomi has skill, and professional fighting pays well. If she competes, she can earn real money. She needs a manager, and with your experience, you are the right person for the job. Training intensifies as you push her to reach her limits, sharpening both her technique and her mindset. She is strong, but the road to becoming a true fighter is brutal. Every day brings new challenges, both inside and outside the ring.

Spending so much time together strengthens your bond with Naomi. Long hours, shared struggles, and physical training sessions create an undeniable closeness. The connection between you deepens, and attraction grows. The choices you make will shape your relationship and define how everything unfolds.

This is a choice-driven visual novel where every decision has consequences. Multiple endings allow for different outcomes, depending on how you handle each situation. Training, relationships, and personal struggles all come into play as the story progresses. The fight world is unforgiving, and your past still lingers, but every moment is another chance to take control of your future.

Martial arts is more than just fighting. It is discipline, strategy, and mental resilience. Everything you do will influence the story, from how you train Naomi to how you deal with the people from your past. The journey ahead is intense, but the path forward is yours to decide.

content_descriptors.notes:
Teach Me Master is an adult visual novel intended only for mature audiences.

Players will encounter mature content rooted in themes of power, redemption, and the consequences of desperate choices. Sexual acts are depicted explicitly through both text and visuals, serving as a narrative device to explore complex relationships, mentorship dynamics, and personal boundaries.

The game features graphic depictions of violence, including hand-to-hand combat, bar brawls, and underground fighting circuits. Blood, injuries, and intense physical confrontations are portrayed unflinchingly, underscoring the brutal realities of martial arts competition and criminal retaliation. Violence is not sensationalised but contextualised within the protagonist’s struggle for survival and control.

References to alcohol abuse and criminal coercion (e.g., loan shark threats, debt-driven exploitation) recur throughout the story. These elements highlight the protagonist’s morally ambiguous decisions and the psychological toll of his past failures.

The use of adult language is prevalent throughout the gameplay experience.
